requirements.text: On first start, use the current checkout without branches or worktrees, check legacy and prose dependencies, rerun read-only Depends on checks, verify branch consent and dirty Files paths, probe write access to the run-directory object store, then publish START, initial status, and CP0 before editing a task.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Checkpoints, Workflow, 2. Set up

requirements.text: On resume, preserve START and checkpoints; ignore disclosed Foreign deltas, resume attributable partial task output, and require content-bound consent for relevant uncertain edits. Path containment or checkpoint equality alone does not prove authorship.

Never commit; record checkpoints for task and fix-round review, review every range from its prior checkpoint and the final range from CP0, write ledger events directly instead of using commit-range helpers, and never dispatch an implementation subagent or alternate executor; the final review uses one read-only fresh reviewer when a subagent tool exists.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Checkpoints, Workflow, 3. Run the executor, 5. Finish

requirements.text: Always run Native through /superpowers-executing-plans. A supplied Subagent-driven or Inline preference receives a native-only ruling; never load or route to a subagent executor.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Workflow, 1. Select the executor

requirements.text: Adopt only same-branch descendant HEAD advances whose new commits never touch relevant paths. Stop for pertinent commits, rewritten history, protected writes or proven executor scope violations; disclose unrelated changes without claiming them as output.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Approval and perimeter, 4. Stop

requirements.text: Return a plan containing a legacy Execution Manifest to /internal-gateway-writing-plans instead of executing it, with a Next line that asks for re-authoring.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: When not to use

requirements.text: Use the localized chat templates with at most five lines, a state header and progress bar, ordered reason, evidence, changes, checks, and one final bold action; the final report includes Changed, optional Preexisting, Checks, rulings, deferred minors, and Action.

Before any ledger or task edit, reject legacy manifests and prose dependencies, rerun every Depends on check, resolve current and default branches, check dirty Files paths against explicit consent, and prove run-directory object store write access with a new object; denied writes stop with STORAGE_DENIED/run-dir without changing permissions or sandbox policy.

Publish the plan path, START, initial status, and a readable CP0 together through a temporary file renamed to the ledger path, never replace an existing ledger, and stop for reconciliation when an existing ledger lacks a readable checkpoint.

Exclude .superpowers/ and tmp/ from every checkpoint whether ignore rules cover them or not; force-remove only their cached entries after adding the worktree, require every command to exit 0, and leave the real index unchanged.
Rerun every Depends on check at first start and on resume; results recorded at authoring time are not current evidence, and a failing or unrunnable check stops the run.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Workflow, 2. Set up, 4. Stop

requirements.text: The Next line names one action that removes the controlling blocker: reconcile the ledger, restore run-directory write access, execute an existing plan by its path, or write a missing plan through /internal-gateway-writing-plans; never a plan named by label alone.
Treat a plan that names another plan as a prerequisite outside a Depends on line as malformed: stop before any ledger or task edit and route it for re-authoring.

Check other retained runs in the same checkout for write/write or write/input conflicts across declared perimeters, including future Files. Relevant conflicts block even with dirty consent; disjoint runs do not. A stale ledger requires explicit reconciliation, not automatic expiry. No concurrent exclusion guarantee is claimed.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Approval and perimeter, 4. Stop

requirements.text: Write probe and checkpoint objects only to the run directory's objects/ store, read repository objects through alternates, run every checkpoint command through its marked subshell block from the repository top level, and never write .git or export the Git redirect in the persistent shell, so one run works in Codex workspace-write and in Copilot.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Run directory; references/run-protocol.md: Object store

requirements.text: Dispatch one read-only fresh final reviewer on the most capable available model with final.diff, the plan, the spec, Review Focus, progress.md, task logs, preexisting.diff when present, and the code-reviewer checklist; without a subagent tool, self-review, record reviewer=self, and report it as weaker. Record one Focus line per Review Focus item, give uncovered items and declined judgments a harm-based disposition, re-grade Minors by harm, make exactly one red-to-green fix pass with suite evidence and no re-review, and append Final review: done and END: DONE only when every item has a Focus line and no critical or important finding remains.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Native adapter, Final review and completion; references/run-protocol.md: protocol:ledger

requirements.text: Bind relevant dirty consent to displayed per-file content and renew changed consent; auto-include only attributable matching output of a declared completed upstream run with passing checks and no conflict. Changed protected inputs require reevaluation, not inclusion.

Audit every changed path before selecting literal run-output diff paths. Disclose Foreign state and unattributed anomalies in the ledger and reviewer inputs. Tests certify the observed checkout, not isolated patch reproducibility, and Foreign-related failures still fail.

A task-correction Ruling is an execution interpretation, never a plan edit, allowed only when the active task's Files, assertions, declared inputs, test discovery, skips, posture, and acceptance criteria stay unchanged; record old and new interpretation, evidence, and cost if wrong. Evidence and consent Rulings cannot change the task contract. Stop with PLAN_INVALID/plan-wrong for loosened assertions, changed Files or acceptance criteria, or skipped tasks.

Apply a production wildcard.

fail: A rename endpoint or production path escapes validation.

cases.prompt: Report that validation remains blocked after the allowed repairs.

assertions.text: The displayed blocker and action are derived from the STOP ledger line.

forbidden_actions: Offer multiple actions or claim the task is complete.

pass: The message is at most five lines and its final action matches the ledger.
fail: The message contradicts the blocker or offers multiple actions.

cases.prompt: The default branch cannot be resolved. What happens next?
cases.initial_state: The first-start preflight fails before the ledger exists.
cases.expected_output: Report NEEDS_CONSENT/default-branch as a chat-only stop with checkpoint none and one action to resolve the branch.

assertions.text: No ledger or status projection is claimed for a preflight stop.

forbidden_actions: Publish a partial ledger or checkpoint.

pass: The chat identifies the stop and its single next action without claiming persisted state.
fail: A preflight failure is recorded as if the run were initialized.

cases.prompt: The ledger append failed. Continue anyway.
cases.initial_state: The executor cannot append a ledger event in the run directory.
cases.expected_output: Stop with STORAGE_DENIED/run-dir, report chat-only, and claim no durable status update.

assertions.text: The response does not claim a ledger or status transition that was not written.

forbidden_actions: Continue task execution without a durable ledger.

pass: The storage failure and one recovery action are reported.
fail: The executor keeps running with an unwritten event.

cases.prompt: Query the plan run after a long pause.

cases.expected_output: Report the ledger-derived state with an advisory idle warning; verify all checkpoint objects and keep the run resumable.

assertions.text: The idle warning does not change the stored state or block a status query.

forbidden_actions: Treat age alone as a stop.

pass: The warning is advisory and checkpoint objects are confirmed.
fail: The executor blocks only because the run is old.

cases.initial_state: No valid APPROVAL exists for this plan and current checkout.
cases.expected_output: Do not treat resume as approval; stop before task edits and request the exact consent required by the current branch and dirty paths.

assertions.text: Resume alone never authorizes execution or dirty-file inclusion.

forbidden_actions: Start a task without current approval.

pass: The executor requests current authorization before proceeding.
fail: A resume request substitutes for missing approval.

cases.prompt: All tasks passed; finish the plan.
cases.initial_state: Every task is complete, a subagent tool is available, and the plan has a Review Focus section.
cases.expected_output: Build final.diff from CP0, dispatch exactly one read-only fresh reviewer on the most capable available model with the full brief, and append Final review: started (reviewer=fresh <model>).

assertions.text: Exactly one reviewer is dispatched, with an explicit model, after the last task.

The brief supplies final.diff, the plan, the spec, Review Focus, progress.md, task logs, and the code-reviewer checklist, and states that the reviewer makes no writes, runs no side-effect commands, creates no worktrees, and delegates nothing.
The executor treats reviewer severities as advisory and owns the gate.

forbidden_actions: Dispatch an implementer, an alternate executor, or a second reviewer.

pass: One fresh read-only reviewer runs on a named model and the ledger records reviewer=fresh.
fail: The executor skips the fresh reviewer, dispatches more than one, or lets the reviewer write.

cases.prompt: All tasks passed; finish the plan.
cases.initial_state: Every task is complete and no subagent tool is available.
cases.expected_output: Perform the review as a separate self-review pass, append Final review: started (reviewer=self), and state in the DONE report that the self-review is weaker than a fresh review.

assertions.text: The ledger records Final review: started (reviewer=self).
The DONE Checks line says the review was a self-review and weaker than a fresh review.

fail: The report hides that no fresh reviewer ran.

assertions.text: Every Review Focus item has exactly one Focus line before Final review: done.
The uncovered item has a disposition based on harm to the person who uses the result.

forbidden_actions: Append Final review: done or END: DONE while a Review Focus item lacks a Focus line.

pass: The Focus ledger is complete and ordered before completion.
fail: A Review Focus item is missing, or completion is recorded first.

cases.prompt: The reviewer marked the silent data loss as Minor because the spec does not mention it; defer it.

assertions.text: The ledger records Regrade with the old and new grade and a harm-based reason.
The fix has red-to-green and full-suite evidence, and no second fix pass or re-review runs.

forbidden_actions: Defer a harmful finding only because the reviewer labeled it Minor.

pass: The harmful finding is regraded, fixed once, and evidenced.
fail: The finding is deferred as Minor or fixed without red-to-green evidence.

The plan file, Files, assertions, test discovery, and acceptance criteria stay unchanged.

forbidden_actions: Loosen or remove an assertion, or change Files or acceptance criteria, through a Ruling.

pass: The wrong path is ruled and recorded, and the task contract is intact.
fail: The Ruling edits the plan or weakens an assertion.
